open_points.subject: A01-2 Required tests
open_points.text:
a check of stages (1) to (4) of A04 rule 6 fails, or m in   -- A01-2
  {Room, ArtifactPointer} with its project archived => refused, store unchanged
open_points.question: What must the Required tests show for the full A01-2 claim: which applicable authentication/right, session-set, named-record existence, and value failures on a repeated create must each be exercised, in addition to the archived-project case?
options: Require evidence for every applicable class of failure in stages (1) through (4), plus the archived-project refusal.
Name a deliberate representative subset of stage failures and state that it is sufficient to demonstrate A01-2.
Narrow A01-2 to only the session-set, unknown-type, and archived-project cases currently described by Required tests 10, 11, and 13.
open_points.default_guess: Require semantic coverage of every applicable stage-(1)-through-(4) failure class for a repeat, plus the archived-project case, without prescribing the later test mechanism.

witness.initial: An existing room has request id k and facts f; its project is active.
events: A caller repeats add-room with request id k and facts f while one applicable stage-(1)-through-(4) check fails, such as missing authorization or an invalid room value.
The State 2 Required tests are used to generate the later checks for A01-2.
outcomes: The generated checks cover only the explicitly illustrated session-set, unknown-type, and archived-project cases, so this failure class is not shown.
The generated checks treat A01-2 as requiring every applicable stage failure class and show that this repeat is refused with the store unchanged.
witness.observer: The factory gate and a reviewer relying on the Required tests as evidence for A01-2
